invariants.rationale: All float values are greater than or equal to Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY.
All float values are less than or equal to Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY.
A float value cannot be both NaN and infinite at the same time.
A float is either finite, infinite, or NaN; if it is not infinite, it must be finite or NaN.
This checks that offsetY is not NaN, as NaN is not equal to itself.
